title: Little Nemo: The Dream Master - Nightmare Land
description:
Little Nemo was a fun little game for the NES. This track is lively and dynamic but tense. It would be good for late game levels.

Requested by Darkbloom. Samples are the NES synth sample sets by musicalman from Samples of Insanity.
